Estimated from the photo, the tray holds four items:
- Chow mein noodles, about 250 g, roughly 400 kcal (about 12 g protein, 55 g carbs, 15 g fat).
- Sliced roast chicken with skin, about 100 g, roughly 200 kcal (about 25 g protein, 0 g carbs, 11 g fat).
- A chocolate bar in a brown wrapper, probably a cereal or protein bar of about 40 g, roughly 190 kcal (about 3 g protein, 25 g carbs, 9 g fat).
- A glass of orange juice, about 250 ml, roughly 110 kcal (about 1 g protein, 26 g carbs, 0 g fat).

Together that is about 900 kcal served.

I can't tell from a before-eating photo what will be left over, so I assumed a modest amount: about 10% of the noodles and a little of the chicken skin, around 60 kcal. That leaves about 840 kcal eaten.

Macros eaten, adjusted for that leftover:
- Protein: about 39 g
- Carbohydrates: about 102 g
- Fat: about 33 g
